description: Creates a new, empty Google Calendar with the specified title (summary). Newly created calendars default to UTC timezone; use googlecalendar.patch_calendar afterward to set the desired timeZone if needed.

summary.description: Title for the new Google Calendar to be created. Required and must be a non-empty string.
summary.human_parameter_description: The name you want to give the new calendar. Pick a clear title to help you recognize it later.
summary.title: Summary

name: duplicate_calendar

allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.description: The types of conference solutions supported for this calendar. Read-only. Possible values include: 'eventHangout', 'eventNamedHangout', 'hangoutsMeet'.
allowedConferenceSolutionTypes.title: Allowed Conference Solution Types

DuplicateCalendarResponse.description:
Response is the Google Calendar API Calendar resource itself.

Per non-negotiable response rules, we return the API resource directly
without wrapping (removed prior 'calendar_data' wrapper).

conferenceProperties.description: Conferencing properties for this calendar. Read-only.
conferenceProperties.title: Conference Properties

display_url.description: Direct URL to the calendar's settings page in the Google Calendar web interface
display_url.title: Display Url

etag.description: ETag of the resource. Used for caching and concurrency control. Read-only.
etag.title: Etag

id.description: Identifier of the calendar, typically an email-like value (e.g., the calendar's primary email address). Read-only.
id.title: Id

kind.description: Type of the resource. Always 'calendar#calendar'. Read-only.
kind.title: Kind

location.description: Geographic location of the calendar as free-form text. Optional.
location.title: Location

summary.description: Title or display name of the calendar.
summary.title: Summary

timeZone.description: The time zone of the calendar, specified as an IANA Time Zone Database name (e.g., 'Europe/Zurich', 'America/Denver', 'Asia/Kolkata'). Optional.
timeZone.title: Time Zone

DuplicateCalendarResponse.title: DuplicateCalendarResponse
